summary: Windows-first local RAG desktop app with WPF/WebView2 shell, in-process ASP.NET Minimal API backend, React/Vite web UI, SQLite plus sqlite-vec local storage, Ollama integration, OCR and Office ingestion support, and Inno Setup packaging.
active_objective: Complete the remaining release-readiness tasks: sign the installer, verify the signed installer lifecycle, run interactive runtime checks, verify optional OCR, and make the final release decision.
assumptions: Generated outputs under bin, obj, dist, node_modules, and artifacts are build artifacts, not source state.
OCR runtime preparation and live Ollama model workflows are optional feature paths unless included in the intended release scope.
Interactive desktop launch and installer lifecycle checks require a Windows desktop session or clean Windows verification machine.

decisions.decision: Treat Windows plus PowerShell 7 as the primary development and release environment.
decisions.impact: Repository commands, path checks, installer verification, and release tasks are evaluated against Windows tooling first.

decisions.decision: Use npm as the frontend package manager because src\OnlyRag.Web\package-lock.json is present and package.json scripts are npm-based.
decisions.impact: Do not introduce pnpm, yarn, or alternate frontend package manager conventions.

decisions.decision: Do not promote installer artifacts as release artifacts until a trusted code-signing certificate, signtool, Inno Setup, and signed lifecycle verification are available.
decisions.impact: Packaging can be verified separately from release; signed release tasks remain blocked.

current_tasks.task: Provision trusted Windows code-signing material outside Git and sign the installer.
prerequisites: Secure password delivery through ONLYRAG_CERT_PASSWORD or an interactive secure prompt
Available Windows SDK signtool.exe and Inno Setup
execution: Place signing material in the approved external location, not in source control.
Run scripts\Sign-Release.ps1 with the trusted certificate and versioned installer artifact.
Confirm the installer Authenticode signature is valid and timestamped.
current_tasks.completion_criteria: artifacts\installer\OnlyRag-Setup-0.1.0-win-x64.exe is signed by the trusted publisher and signature verification passes.

current_tasks.task: Run signed installer lifecycle verification on a clean Windows machine.
prerequisites: Clean Windows verification machine or equivalent disposable VM
execution: Verify install, first launch, upgrade path if applicable, rollback behavior, uninstall, and SmartScreen/signature behavior.
Record any installer findings as blockers before release sign-off.
current_tasks.completion_criteria: Signed installer lifecycle checks pass on a clean Windows environment with no unresolved release-blocking findings.

current_tasks.task: Run interactive desktop and populated browser UI verification.
prerequisites: Ollama endpoint when model-backed workflows are tested
execution: Launch dotnet run --project .\src\OnlyRag.App\OnlyRag.App.csproj --configuration Debug or the installed app.
Verify document import, populated document views, active jobs, retrieval/chat, translation records, settings persistence, and shutdown behavior.
Capture defects with exact workflow, input, expected result, and observed result.
current_tasks.completion_criteria: Core desktop and UI workflows pass with representative local data, or all defects are classified and resolved or accepted before public release.

current_tasks.task: Verify optional OCR setup and Python OCR dependency security posture.
prerequisites: pip-audit or safety available without compromising dependency policy
execution: Audit scripts\ocr\requirements.txt with pip-audit or safety when one is available.
Verify OCR processing on representative scanned documents.
current_tasks.completion_criteria: OCR bootstrap succeeds, OCR dependency audit has no unresolved high-severity findings, and representative OCR processing works.

execution: Re-run the canonical gate after any fixes made during residual verification.
Update PROJECT_STATUS.json quality gates, blockers, risks, and handoff notes to reflect the verified final state.
Promote the artifact only if P0 items are complete and no accepted P1 risk blocks the intended release scope.
current_tasks.completion_criteria: PROJECT_STATUS.json shows no release-blocking blockers, quality gates reflect actual results, and the release decision is explicit.

blockers.reason: No code-signing certificate/private key is present under certificates\app; the generated installer is unsigned.
Install, launch, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, SmartScreen, and signed enforcement checks were not run on a clean Windows verification machine.

risks.description: The installer is valid only as an unsigned package artifact, not as a signed release candidate.
The WPF desktop app and populated live UI workflows still need interactive verification.
OCR runtime setup and Python OCR dependency audit remain unverified for OCR release support.

runtime: Self-contained .NET 10 runtime components in packaged app
Ollama for chat, embeddings, and translation model features
Optional LibreOffice for legacy Office conversion and PDF export
Optional Python 3.10+ PaddleOCR runtime for OCR
development: Windows SDK signtool.exe for signed release candidates
external_services: Ollama endpoint, local or explicitly trusted non-loopback
RFC 3161 timestamp server for release signing

commands.dev: Set-Location .\src\OnlyRag.Web; npm run dev; dotnet run --project .\src\OnlyRag.App\OnlyRag.App.csproj --configuration Debug
commands.build: Set-Location .\src\OnlyRag.Web; npm run build; Set-Location ..\..; dotnet build .\OnlyRag.sln --configuration Release --no-restore

last_completed_work: Stabilized repository state for release readiness: reviewed the working tree, confirmed only PROJECT_STATUS.json changed, and recorded the remaining release blockers explicitly.
handoff_notes: Repository state has been stabilized for the current release-readiness pass. Do not call this a signed production release until the remaining P0 tasks are complete: installer signed and clean-machine signed installer lifecycle verification passed.
